# The 54 chart types

Every example is drawn as what the chart is named after. The name only decides the look: any type can carry any subject (a pie chart can be a pie, an umbrella seen from above, or an electricity meter). Pick the type for the question, then pick the subject.

Look at an example: `python3 assets/build.py --examples <id> -o look.html`. Read its code: search `assets/examples.js` for `card({id:'<id>'`.

| Type | id | Use it for | Example subject |
|---|---|---|---|
| Architecture | `arch` | how the parts of a system hand work to each other | a corner bakery, cellar to loft |
| Bar chart | `bar` | comparing amounts across a few groups | chocolate bars sold in one week |
| Beeswarm | `bees` | every single value at once, when there are dozens to a few hundred | bees at the lavender |
| Box plot | `box` | how spread out each group is: middle, usual range, odd ones | how long the post takes |
| Bubble chart | `bubble` | three numbers per item: position, position and size | the best bubble soap |
| Calendar heatmap | `calendar` | a daily number across weeks or a year | km walked in June |
| Candlestick | `candles` | start, end, high and low for each period | a week in the greenhouse |
| Decision tree | `tree` | choices that lead to outcomes | which tea, right now? |
| Doughnut chart | `doughnut` | parts of a whole, with the total in the middle | a box of twelve |
| Entity relationship | `er` | what records exist and how they link | the village library |
| Exploded view | `exploded` | what something is made of, layer by layer | a good sandwich |
| Fishbone | `fishbone` | the causes behind one problem | why the cake sank |
| Floor plan | `plan` | where things are in a space | a one-room flat |
| Flowchart | `flow` | a process with decisions and branches | watering the garden from the rain butt |
| Funnel | `funnel` | how many are left after each step | a birthday, from invite to cake |
| Gantt | `gantt` | tasks over time, and what overlaps | getting Sunday lunch on the table |
| Gauge | `gauge` | one number against its safe range | the oven dial |
| Hexbin | `hexbin` | where thousands of points crowd together | one frame of honeycomb |
| Kanban | `kanban` | what is to do, doing and done | moving house |
| Lasagna plot | `lasagna` | many rows of the same timeline, coloured by state | one family, one week of sleep |
| Line chart | `line` | how one or two numbers change over time | a week of drying weather |
| Lollipop | `lollipop` | ranking many items by one number | sweets sold, one week |
| Loop | `loop` | a cycle that comes back round | a coffee pot's day |
| Manhattan plot | `manhattan` | many values along a long line, where the peaks matter | walkers on 14 avenues |
| Mind map | `mind` | ideas branching from one centre | planning a picnic |
| Nested | `nested` | things inside things | one doll inside another |
| Org chart | `org` | who reports to whom | a small town library |
| Pie chart | `pie` | parts of a whole, a few slices | one Sunday, 24 hours |
| Pyramid | `pyramid` | levels that narrow toward the top | what a cat needs |
| Quadrant | `quad` | sorting things on two yes/no questions | where to sit on the quad |
| Radar | `radar` | one thing scored on five to eight qualities | two bikes compared |
| Raincloud plot | `raincloud` | the spread of each group, with every value shown | three ways to get to work |
| Ridgeline | `ridge` | how a spread shifts across many groups or times | walkers on the hill, by hour |
| Rose diagram | `rose` | amounts by month, season or direction | a year of rain |
| Sankey | `sankey` | where an amount comes from and where it goes | where a farm's milk goes |
| Scatter | `scatter` | whether two numbers move together | every mug in the cupboard |
| Sequence | `seq` | messages passed between people or systems, in order | ordering a flat white |
| Slopegraph | `slope` | before and after for a handful of items | snow on four pistes |
| Spaghetti plot | `spaghetti` | many lines over the same time, one picked out | seven children, growing up |
| Spectrum | `spectrum` | where things sit between two ends | how hot each chilli is |
| Stacked bar | `stacked` | totals and what each is made of | a chocolate kitchen's week |
| State machine | `state` | the states something can be in and what moves it on | the kettle |
| Step line | `steps` | a number that changes in jumps | the climb to the hut |
| Sunburst | `sunburst` | a whole split into parts, and those into smaller parts | a year in the garden |
| Swimlane | `swim` | who does which step of a shared process | breakfast for two |
| Timeline | `timeline` | events in order, with real gaps | one tomato plant |
| Treemap | `treemap` | many parts of a whole, sized by amount | an orchard of 100 trees |
| User journey | `journey` | what someone does and feels, step by step | a train to the seaside |
| Venn | `venn` | what overlaps between two or three groups | breakfast or pudding? |
| Violin plot | `violin` | the shape of a spread, group by group | weekly practice, by player |
| Volcano plot | `volcano` | many changes: how big and how sure | forty changes to one cake |
| Waffle chart | `waffle` | one share out of 100, easy to count | 100 Sunday breakfasts |
| Waterfall chart | `waterfall` | how a start value becomes an end value, step by step | the rain barrel, one week |
| Word cloud | `wordcloud` | which words come up most | a week of weather forecasts |
